name: evidence-lab-plugins
description: Evidence Lab agent-first research packs for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: evidence-lab-core
plugins.description: Agent-first research foundations, fast researcher onboarding, personal skill creation, reproducible pack selection, source verification, citation handling, and scientific critical thinking.

plugins.name: life-sciences
plugins.description: Domain checks for life-science protocols, biological controls, bias, biosafety boundaries, reporting context, and image acquisition metadata.

plugins.name: quantitative-sciences
plugins.description: Statistical analysis, power and sample-size planning, uncertainty and units, and publication-grade scientific visualization for quantitative research.

plugins.name: data-and-pdf
plugins.description: Compatibility entry point for mixed document-and-data projects; installs focused document-evidence and structured-data-analysis packs as dependencies.

plugins.name: document-evidence
plugins.description: Reproducible conversion of supported research documents into inspectable Markdown without installing database retrieval or dataset analysis tools.

plugins.name: evidence-lab-meeting-capture
plugins.description: Turn Evidence Lab meeting transcripts or notes into source-bounded summaries and register each completed summary in the canonical Notion meeting database.

plugins.name: full-research-cycle
plugins.description: Compatibility entry point for the complete research cycle; installs the focused research-design and literature-publication packs as declared dependencies.

plugins.name: literature-publication
plugins.description: Literature synthesis, evidence-bounded academic writing, editable research diagrams, and manuscript review without installing study-design procedures.

plugins.name: publication-monitoring
plugins.description: Repeatable monitoring of new scholarly publications with explicit queries, stable deduplication, checkpoints, and source-linked update digests.

plugins.name: qualitative-research
plugins.description: Traceable qualitative-text analysis using an explicit codebook, coded excerpts, reflexive notes, disagreements, and evidence-bounded thematic synthesis.

plugins.name: research-design
plugins.description: Testable hypothesis development and reproducible experimental or observational study design without unrelated literature or manuscript tooling.

plugins.name: research-images
plugins.description: Research-image inspection with explicit source identity, transformation history, measurement definitions, exclusions, and interpretation boundaries.

plugins.name: structured-data-analysis
plugins.description: Reproducible public-database retrieval and exploratory analysis for tables and datasets without unrelated document-conversion tooling.

plugins.name: systematic-review
plugins.description: Reproducible systematic-search and screening workflow with explicit eligibility criteria, stable record deduplication, and an auditable decision trail.
